metadata.methods_description: Long-term iEEG data were invasively recorded from bilateral epileptic lesion areas in epilepsy patients implanted with RNS devices. Each recording contains 90 seconds of dual-channel iEEG data centered on each stimulation event (60 seconds before onset, ~30 seconds after end). Stimulation markers with onset and duration are stored in events.tsv files, and electrical stimulation parameters set during clinical follow-up are stored in ieeg.json files. Data were saved in EDF format and organized according to BIDS. Patients were included if seizure events were recorded intracranially for more than six months, with each session representing one week of recordings. Technical validation was performed using power spectral analysis, envelope length calculation, and phase locking value calculation.
